The shelves are arranged in a grid-like pattern and are filled with different types of snacks and drinks. On the left side of the image, there is a large display case filled with a variety of snacks, including chips, crackers, and other snacks. In the background, there are several hot air balloons hanging from the ceiling, adding a festive touch to the space. The floor is tiled and there are large windows on the right side, allowing natural light to enter the store.
